overview: The Medford School Committee accepted a $25,000 scholarship donation, a $50,000 Italian language program grant, and school library memorial gifts. The committee also received updates on traffic crosswalk timing and student community projects.

items.title: Holiday Music Presentation
items.summary: The committee heard a holiday orchestra performance by students under the direction of Tony Szykniej.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the December 5, 2016 meeting with an added directive for the superintendent to track policy development on student issues occurring outside school.

items.title: Approval of Bills, Transfers, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved bills, fund transfers, and payrolls following inquiry regarding specific vendor reimbursements.

items.title: Crosswalk Signal Update at Fulton Street and Fellsway
items.summary: Accepted a report detailing extended pedestrian crossing timing and planned signal improvements at Fulton Street and the Fellsway.

items.title: Leah R. Kaleri-Clark Memorial Scholarship Gift
items.summary: Accepted a $25,000 donation from Professor Emeritus Edward Clark to establish an English studies scholarship honoring former department director Leah R. Kaleri-Clark.

items.title: Margaret Weigel Memorial Donation
items.summary: Accepted a $2,000 donation from co-workers of Margaret Weigel to purchase new books for the Columbus Elementary School library.

items.title: Columbus School Celebration of Cultures Night Report
items.summary: Accepted a report summarizing the Columbus Elementary School's second annual Celebration of Cultures event.

items.title: Columbus School Little Free Library and Student Projects Report
items.summary: Accepted reports on the installation of a Little Free Library at Columbus Elementary School and a student fleece blanket drive for the Home for Little Wanderers.

items.title: Global Scholars Program Museum of Science Trip Report
items.summary: Accepted a report on a seventh-grade Global Scholars program field trip to the Museum of Science focused on engineering and innovation.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Passed condolence resolutions for Marvin Brown, Cleveland Red Honeycutt, Mary Alice Leach, Jean Barry Sutherland, and Joseph C. Bettinelli, and voted to dedicate the meeting to Jean Barry Sutherland.

items.title: CASIT Grant for Italian Language Program
items.summary: Accepted a $50,000 grant from CASIT to support elementary Italian language instruction.
